bbb.title: Big Buck Bunny
bbb.description: A good-natured giant rabbit gets even with three rodents who spoil his day. Open movie from the Blender Foundation's Peach project.

sintel.title: Sintel
sintel.description: A lone young woman crosses a harsh land to find the baby dragon she once rescued. Open movie from the Blender Foundation's Durian project.
sintel.attribution: Sintel (c) 2010 Blender Foundation, durian.blender.org. Licensed under CC BY 3.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0). Re-encoded for this demo.

tos.title: Tears of Steel
tos.description: In a future Amsterdam, warriors and scientists replay a decades-old break-up to stop an army of robots. Live-action open movie from the Blender Foundation's Mango project.
tos.attribution: Tears of Steel (c) 2012 Blender Foundation, mango.blender.org. Licensed under CC BY 3.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0). Re-encoded for this demo.

ed.title: Elephants Dream
ed.description: Two men wander through an endless, living machine and disagree about what it is. The first open movie, from the Orange Open Movie Project.
